name: Portales (United States)
description: A landscape: a yellow sun with red rays rising over a blue sky, above ploughed fields fanning out in stripes of brown and green.
history: Portales is a city in and the county seat of Roosevelt County, New Mexico. The flag was adopted in 2009 (the winner of a competition held for the city's incorporation centennial, to be unveiled by the council on 19 May 2009 and inaugurated on 16 June 2009, according to Flags of the World citing the Portales News-Tribune).

features.role: ploughed fields in brown and green fanning out to the horizon
